_comment: max_price is the ALL-IN dollar price per ticket. party_size must appear in a listing's purchasable lot sizes, so 1 excludes pairs-only listings. tiers lists the seat groups worth sitting in, per venue; a venue not listed here is never checked. Use "*" to accept every tier at a venue.
_ashe_note: Promenade is deliberately excluded. It is the only Ashe tier ever under $200, and it is the top of a 24,000-seat stadium. Add it here if you decide cheap-and-far beats not-going.
